title: anthriscus sylvestris proles elatior
intro: Anthriscus sylvestris proles elatior, commonly known as Wild or Garden Chervil, is a biennial flowering plant in the carrot family, closely related to parsley and celery. The plant has been used in herbal medicine for its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving digestion, and acting as a natural antiseptic. Wild Chervil's therapeutic actions include its ability to stimulate the appetite, reduce fever, and alleviate respiratory issues such as bronchitis and asthma. The bioactive constituents present in Wild Chervil include volatile oils, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
